description:
Stop (turn off) a computer now. Everything on it is kept; a stopped computer costs only storage and starts again by itself the next time a tool uses it. Running commands are ended.

WHEN TO USE: the work is done and the person won't need it for a while. Computers also stop by themselves after 15 idle minutes, so this is optional.

RETURNS: the computer's name and new state.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

name: computer_stop
